# Throughout (PVT) LTD

> Throughout is an offshore software development studio in Colombo, Sri Lanka. We design, build and grow websites, web and mobile apps, MVPs and SaaS platforms, and provide dedicated development teams for founders, agencies and businesses in Australia, Europe and beyond.

Website: https://www.throughout.io (a single page; sections linked below)

## Services

- [Software development](https://www.throughout.io/#services): Website and web app development, mobile app development, SaaS and MVP development, AI and workflow automation, Shopify and e-commerce, cloud, DevOps and QA.
- [UI/UX and website design](https://www.throughout.io/#services): Product strategy and UX research, UI/UX design for web and mobile, website and landing page design, prototypes, design systems, brand identity.
- [SEO and digital marketing](https://www.throughout.io/#services): SEO services, content strategy, Google and Meta ads, conversion optimisation, email and messaging campaigns, analytics.
- [Dedicated development teams](https://www.throughout.io/#engagement-models): Hire dedicated developers, designers, QA and marketers who work inside your tools and roadmap. English-speaking team on GMT+5:30, overlapping with Australia, Europe and the Gulf. Or hire a project team for a defined website, app or MVP.

## Work

- [Products we built and run](https://www.throughout.io/#work): Rankout (AI SEO platform), Checkout (offline-first POS), Tryout (custom T-shirt design and printing), Comflo (customer conversations and orders), Spendout (free expense tracker with Gmail receipts).
- [Client projects](https://www.throughout.io/#work): Throughout CRM, Naaraa Biznet, Findout, Montado Coffee, Rataa Backdrops, NRS Optical, Ado Coffee, Hostraspace, Artisans Touch.
- [Case study: Comflo retention campaign](https://www.throughout.io/#case-study): 28.6x return on ad spend in 24 hours. 200 existing customers reached on WhatsApp, LKR 1,400 spent, LKR 40,000+ revenue.
- [Case study: Müllwood SEO and AI search](https://www.throughout.io/#seo-case-study): Three months of SEO, AEO and GEO for mullwood.lk, Sri Lanka's first curly hair brand. Structured data coverage 0% to 100%, 20 pages and products given SEO titles and keywords, 671 images without alt text fixed, blog grown from 1 to 13 articles, AI crawler access, llms.txt, Bing and IndexNow.
- [Case study: CoreConnect group SEO](https://www.throughout.io/#seo-case-study-coreconnect): Month 1 of SEO, AEO and GEO across three sites owned by CoreConnect Distributions: aerixlk.com, airmatelk.com and coreconnect.lk. Aerix URLs with SEO titles and metas 0% to 90%, Airmate pages and products with SEO titles 0 to 61, CoreConnect structured data 0% to 100%, 8 answer-ready guides published, 246 images given alt text, brand relationships stated in schema.
